featured_reviews.name: Vedna Mulloo
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Dad recently needed specialised injections prescribed just 2 days before Holi and we were due to take the plane the next day- this meant suppliers were closed on Holi. Wellness Forever stretched themselves to get the injections. On time and with constant updates. And packed the injections in a refrigerated box.

The staff were always courteous, friendly and extremely responsive. Truly grateful to them and highly recommended any time. Thank you!

featured_reviews.name: abhishek yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wellness Forever service or staff is very good, they give first priority to customers.
They talk and give suggestions very well, there are some shortcomings everywhere, everyone cannot be blamed for this, their nature and behavior is somewhere good, this is what my experience says.
